Abella, J.P., Motazedi, K., Guo, J., Cousart, K., Jing, L. and Bergerson, J.A. (2021). Petroleum Refinery Life Cycle Inventory Model (PRELIM) v1.5: User Guide and Technical Documentation. Department of Chemical and Petroleum Engineering, University of Calgary. (Title page dated Oct 2020; change record dates the v1.5 release October 4, 2021.)

Superseded by v1.6 (abella_2022_001, other-reports/abella_2022_prelim-v1-6_ucalgary). 157-page user guide and technical documentation of PRELIM v1.5. Its default process energy table (Table 4) is word-for-word identical to the v1.6 documentation Table 4 (and to Abella and Bergerson 2012 SI Table S3), and its validation tables (12-17) repeat in v1.6. The v1.5 workbook is not held; the v1.6 workbook defaults supersede it. Nothing extracted.
